title: {item:essentialcraft5:neuronic_enriched_plating}
summary: The base material of this part of the book

blocks.text: Goal: make {item:essentialcraft5:neuronic_enriched_plating}. The Holopad needs one, and almost every part of the Computer Guy's Suit needs it too: it is the material these last two chapters use the most.

items: Pressure Stabilizers, Repulsion Generators, Thruster Engines, Speaker Plates, the Vision Lens and the Computer Engine all use it ([[computer/drives]]);
each piece of the suit and the board itself takes 2 or 3 more. The whole suit plus the board takes <t>17</t> crafts ([[computer/costs]]).

blocks.title: Done when
blocks.text: You have a Neuronic Enriched Plating.
